notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Gluttonous Troll, adding one mana of any color.
Gluttonous Troll dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Gluttonous Troll from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Gluttonous Troll enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least two Food artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Foods, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
